dedupe_keys.name: national land numerical information ksj port data c02 and port area data c18 japan

description: The port data (C02) of Japan's National Land Numerical Information (KSJ) cover all ports designated under the Port and Harbour Act. Each port point carries its class under the port survey rules and the Act (such as specially important, important or local ports), name, code, administrative area, port manager, designation and establishment dates, related maritime agencies (coast guard, customs, quarantine and others), lengths of outer facilities (breakwaters, seawalls, locks) and mooring facilities (quays, piers), and ferry service, with port area and harbour limit lines. It was compiled by MLIT from nautical charts, lists of port managers and other sources, based on product specification 2.0 for fiscal years 2006 and 2008; an older port area dataset (C18) dates from 1985. Coverage is national (Japan). The data are free to download from the KSJ site as JPGIS XML files, for non-commercial use only. Caveats: the facility lengths are values used for local allocation tax and differ from actual lengths, and the data are old. They support exposure of ports to tsunami, storm surge and sea level rise and port network models. They complement the KSJ railway data and are related to the MLIT port statistics.
